# Support

qBitFusion is maintained in spare time and there is no support service.

- **How qBittorrent works in general** (settings, trackers, categories, RSS, search plugins): the
  [qBittorrent wiki](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/wiki/) applies here too.
- **A problem that only happens in qBitFusion:** open a bug report in this repository.
- **A problem that also happens in stock qBittorrent:** report it to
  [qBittorrent](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/issues), following their rules.
- **Your debrid account** (billing, availability, limits): contact the provider.

Please do not ask the qBittorrent project for help with qBitFusion.
